name: ev_rdu_ipmsm_improved_v2
_comment: Improved EV IPMSM. Parametric steps that flow straight into the NX journal: (1) demag -> N42EH magnet (Hcj 2388 kA/m vs SH 1592) + thicker 5.5 mm magnet -> first-order demag margin x0.48 -> x0.88 @150C; (3) cooling -> 16 jacket channels; (4) iron loss -> 0.20 mm laminations + 6 magnet eddy-segments (the analytic loss model is thickness-insensitive; the benefit shows up only in FEMM/Bertotti); (5) cogging -> rotor 4-step skew, auto 1 slot pitch; (6) rotor stress -> thicker outer bridge + centre post -> SF 1.50 -> 1.59 OK. NOT applied: (2) saliency/torque needs an FEMM-guided double-layer flux-barrier redesign (a blind v_angle change breaks the V-corner geometry); (7) drive-cycle (WLTP) optimisation is a sweep (batch_build + sweep_example.json). Confirm torque/efficiency/demag in FEMM before freezing.
